column3: Fight your rival in Silent Town
Travel through Route 101 / Silent Hills to Pagota City
Use Cut to progress through Route 102
Fight your rival near the Westport gate
Reach Teknos City and investigate the missing-child/Boulder Mines situation
Return toward Teknos and trigger the Team Rocket takeover
Enter Teknos Aquarium and defeat the Rocket members
Receive Professor Oak's call about Birdon Town / Slowpoke Well
Fight your rival inside Slowpoke Well
Clear Team Rocket out of Slowpoke Well
Continue through the newly opened routes toward Sanskrit Town and Sunpoint City
Reach Sunpoint City and Sunpoint Docks
Enter the Team Rocket house in Sanskrit
Return to Team Rocket's ship at Sunpoint Docks
Use the key and finish exploring the ship
Confront the Rocket captain and Impostor Oak
Discover that Pryce is not available at his Gym
Speak to Pryce again in Frostpoint
Head toward Stand City through Route 112
Fight your rival at the Stand City gate
After the Gym, watch the Impostor Oak presentation
Enter the Team Rocket Hideout in Stand City
Fly or travel back to Westport City
Travel through National Park → Route 113 → Route 114
Explore Kanto and make your way toward its Victory Road / Indigo Plateau
Defeat the four trainers inside the final Gym
Use the newly opened Route 115 shortcut back toward Silent Town
Return to Alloy City and speak with the old man about the legendary Pokémon
Go back to Brass Tower and catch Ho-Oh
Optional but significant: return to the Alloy old man after catching Ho-Oh
With all eight badges, head toward Crown Pass
Fight your rival in Crown Pass
Resume the game after the credits
Go to Oak's Lab in Silent Town
Complete the S.S. Aqua ship sequence
Return to your cabin and sleep
Discover that the S.S. Aqua's Fuel Line is broken
Pass through the Battle Tower area and continue into the island chain
Progress through the Southwest Islands toward Kume City
Reach Ryukyu City along the way
Optional: defeat Trevor in Ryukyu's unofficial Gym
Continue through the islands until Kume City
Find the parts shop in Kume City and obtain the replacement Fuel Line
Return to Amami Docks with the Fuel Line
Give the Fuel Line to the ship crew
The repaired ship also opens additional Southwest Islands content
Forked Strait's locked progression also becomes accessible
In Gold 97 Reforged, the Lugia event is now available because you repaired the S.S. Aqua
Return to Nanjo Forest with Ho-Oh and Lugia
The Tri-Wing makes the legendary birds available
Optional Rival Battle #6 in Nanjo Forest
Enter Rainbow Island with Ho-Oh and Lugia in your party
Go into the Rainbow Island cave
Talk to Blue while carrying Ho-Oh and Lugia
Move to the opposite side of the waterfall as instructed
Continue to the upper section of Rainbow Island
